title: Composed supervisory control: Safety-zone actuator arbitration -> Three-conveyor downstream interlock

inputs.name: A_RobotRequest
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Robot requests the shared zone

inputs.name: A_ConveyorRequest
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Conveyor requests the shared zone

outputs.name: A_Conflict
outputs.description: Subsystem A: More than one eligible request

outputs.name: B_Blocked
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Run request blocked by availability or occupancy

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Loss of A_GuardClosed or A_EStopOK shall disable all grants.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Authorized A_ManualRequest has highest priority.
requirements.property: G((A_ManualRequest AND A_ManualKey AND A_GuardClosed AND A_EStopOK) -> A_ManualEnable)

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_RobotRequest has priority over A_ConveyorRequest when manual mode is not granted.
requirements.property: G((A_RobotRequest AND !A_ManualEnable AND A_GuardClosed AND A_EStopOK) -> A_RobotEnable)

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: At most one grant shall be TRUE.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Conflict shall indicate more than one eligible request before arbitration.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_C3Run shall require B_RunRequest, B_C3Available, B_C3Clear, and not B_Stop.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_C3Run = (B_RunRequest AND B_C3Available AND B_C3Clear AND !B_Stop)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_C2Run shall require B_C3Run, B_C2Available, and B_C2Clear.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_C2Run -> (B_C3Run AND B_C2Available AND B_C2Clear)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_C1Run shall require B_C2Run and B_C1Clear.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Stop shall turn all three commands off.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Blocked shall indicate B_RunRequest with at least one unavailable or uncleared stage.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Blocked = (B_RunRequest AND (!B_C1Clear OR !B_C2Clear OR !B_C3Clear OR !B_C2Available OR !B_C3Available))))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_RobotEnable shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_C1Run AND NOT B_C2Run AND NOT B_C3Run AND NOT B_Blocked)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_C1Run AND NOT B_C2Run AND NOT B_C3Run AND NOT B_Blocked))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
